packet.model_contract: Premium growth is same-quarter-prior-year net_earned_premiums/net_written_premiums growth. Core pretax=NEP*(1-underlying_combined_ratio)-catastrophe_losses+favorable_reserve_development+investment_income+other_income_including_interest. Core net income=core pretax*(1-effective_tax_rate); core EPS=core NI/diluted_shares. Cats are positive losses; reserve development positive is favorable. Percent ratios become decimal. Historical core tax/core pretax gives tax rate. Ratio rounding and reporting-basis differences mean underwriting dollars need a residual reconciliation; do not claim exact GAAP underwriting tie. No supported cash-flow/debt/capital projection; acknowledge thin coverage.
packet.analysis_scope: Analyst-defined illustrative scenario model, not official company budget. Derive defensible base from eligible history; bear/bull are adverse/favorable profitability scenarios, not numeric ascending for every driver. Contract bounds are broad guardrails, not prescribed forecast estimates. All market-to-financial mappings are analyst judgments. Finance should map only financially material reference rows (latest history, same-quarter-prior-year baseline, and supporting trends), not repeat every row. No final-period outcomes are supplied. Missing detailed cash, debt, exposure, or portfolio breakdowns must be limitations, not invented observed facts. QA evaluates a transparent illustrative model; uncertainty alone is not an error, but unsupported claims of certainty are.

limitations: Uses only supplied JSON; source URLs and table headers were not independently verified. No remembered target results were used.
The 2026-03-31 cutoff governs information availability, not execution time. All supplied publication dates precede cutoff; no 2026 Q2 outcomes are supplied.
Inputs support an illustrative quarterly core-income model, not an official budget. Scenario choices and market-to-financial relationships remain analyst judgments.
Cash-flow coverage is limited to operating cash flow. Debt, capital, cash balances, exposures, reinsurance structure and investment portfolio detail are insufficient for projections.
No annualization, missing-quarter inference, policy-unit estimates or headcount estimates are used.
